entries.0: Something went wrong at the very beginning. He was loved anyway.
entries.1: The experiment failed. A mascot was born. Nobody has apologised.
entries.2: It was supposed to be a robot. It was a hedgehog-cat. We kept him.
entries.100: Brain melted. Now thinks in pure chaos.
entries.101: He did the math at 400%. The math did him back.
entries.102: Smoke from the ears. Honestly, an improvement in posture.
entries.151: A flawless thought. He's framing it.
entries.200: Serum rejected. Grew an extra eye instead.
entries.201: The serum said no. The eye said hello.
entries.202: Side effect: eyes. Plural. Possibly more later.
entries.251: The chaos behaved. Everyone is nervous.
entries.300: Came back older and more unhinged.
entries.301: He visited Tuesday. Tuesday is not recovering.
entries.302: Returned five minutes early. Refuses to say what he saw.
entries.350: He saw the future. He won't say.
entries.351: A glimpse of tomorrow. It had snacks.
entries.400: Ate it. Now speaks only in memes.
entries.401: Forbidden for a reason. He's still chewing.
entries.402: It tasted like "wen". He has not stopped asking.
entries.451: Not a single side effect. Terrifying.
entries.500: Floated off. Left his shadow behind.
entries.501: Gravity was optional. He chose wrong.
entries.502: Rose three feet. The ceiling was not consulted.
entries.551: Floated, then landed. Graceful, by his standards.
entries.600: The rack looked back. Now there are two of him.
entries.601: Something in the logs waved. He waved back.
entries.602: A cold draught. A faint echo. He's fine, he says. Twice.
entries.650: A friendly ghost waved. Nothing followed him home.
entries.651: The haunting was polite. He tipped his hat.
entries.1000: His first scar. He's weirdly proud.
entries.1001: A breakthrough. Nobody knows what to do with it.
entries.1002: Ten failures survived. He's basically seasoned.
entries.1003: Twenty-five experiments. He's earned a lanyard.
entries.1004: Three failures in a row. He's still smiling.
entries.1005: Six in a row. He's stopped asking why.
entries.1006: Nine in a row. At this point it's a lifestyle.
entries.1007: People are starting to know him. He's handling it badly.
entries.1008: Marked. The scars have become a personality.
entries.1009: Legendary. Mascots are born from failure. He's proof.
entries.2001: Paradox: he met himself coming back. They didn't get along.
entries.2002: Brainrot: forbidden snack, overclocked brain. Say less.
entries.2003: Chaos Engine: the chaos now has a motor.
entries.3000: A new keeper. The scars stayed.

originCinematic: Once, someone asked an AI for a robot.
It made a hedgehog-cat with a frog for a dad.
The experiment failed. Everyone loved him anyway.
Let's give him a life worth scarring.

1.name: Known
1.tagline: People wave. He waves back, mostly.

2.name: Marked
2.tagline: The scars have become a personality.

3.name: Legendary
3.tagline: He has seen things. He survived them.

afterSuccess: A good day. Don't tell the others.
